title: shell
body:
## shell

Make a uniform-wall housing, cup or tube from the current Body solid with native PartDesign Thickness. Specify wall thickness once and choose exact directional planar opening faces. Inward preserves the exterior; outward grows it. Sharp joins intersect offsets; rounded joins add native arcs where required. The wall, opening links and native affine driver remain editable, and following sketches can attach to the resulting cavity floor. Only the implemented native Skin mode is exposed.

Native binding: `PartDesign::Thickness`. Output kind: `["solid"]`.

| Input port | Multiplicity | Required | Kind |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `base` | one node | yes | `solid` |

| Option | Meaning | Type / constraints | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `thickness` | Positive uniform wall thickness in millimetres, default 2. It controls all remaining walls; inward offsets preserve exterior dimensions. Use drive.thickness instead of a literal for a native named length relationship. | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"exclusiveMinimum":true,"maximum":100000}` | `2` |
| `openings` | Required list of1–12 distinct directional planar opening intents. Each resolves exactly one face to remove from the current base; missing, equally extreme or duplicate resolved faces fail rather than choosing a first face. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"face":{"type":"enum","values":["top","bottom","right","left","back","front"],"required":true},"position":{"type":"enum","values":["outermost","innermost"],"default":"outermost"}}},"minItems":1,"maxItems":12}` | **required** |
| `side` | Wall growth direction: inward (default) preserves the exterior and offsets into the stock; outward preserves the original interior and grows the exterior. Openings remain the selected removed faces. | `{"type":"enum","values":["inward","outward"]}` | `"inward"` |
| `corners` | Offset join intent: sharp (default) extends offset faces to their intersection; rounded joins outward convex offsets with arcs of wall-thickness radius. Some inward offsets have identical geometry for both choices; native join settings still persist. | `{"type":"enum","values":["sharp","rounded"]}` | `"sharp"` |
| `intersectionHandling` | Enable the native intersection handler, defaultfalse. It is an incomplete upstream offset method; leave false unless needed and verify the resulting geometry. Assignment/readback does not establish general offset healing. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `false` |
